technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
hydrogel process with typical parameters representing production technolog of mid 90s

# Included processes
This module contains material and energy input, water consumption as well as emissions and waste amounts from the production of zeolithe out of aluminium hydrate, sodium silicate and sodium hydroxide. Transport and infrastructure have been estimated.
